title: Tenant Brand Config
description: Build-time input consumed by mobile/src/theme/brand/resolveBrandTheme.ts to produce one tenant's branded Student App build (spec 013, FR-011/FR-012). Supplied once per CI build, per docs/architecture/04-Architecture.md's existing per-tenant-flavor pipeline. Never stored in the companies table (see research.md #3).

companyId.description: The Company (specs/001-company-role-user-setup) this brand belongs to. Traceability only — not a foreign key, since this file is not a database row.

accentColor.description: Overrides colors.primary for this build only. Must pass a WCAG 2.1 AA (4.5:1) contrast check against colors.background, colors.surface, and colors.textPrimary before it is applied; on failure the build falls back to the Design Token Set's default colors.primary (FR-012).

logoAssetPath.description: Build-relative path to this tenant's app icon/splash logo asset. Optional — if omitted, the platform default logo is used.

appDisplayName.description: Overrides the app's display name (app store name / home-screen label) for this tenant's build.
